description: This file provides Icelandic localization strings for the Select2 JavaScript library version 4.0.6-rc.1. It defines translation functions for various UI messages such as input length warnings, loading messages, and selection limits.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns Icelandic message indicating input is too long and should be shortened.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns Icelandic message indicating input is too short and additional characters are needed.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns Icelandic message indicating more results are being fetched.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns Icelandic message indicating the maximum number of items that can be selected.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns Icelandic message indicating no search results were found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns Icelandic message indicating a search is in progress.
